title: AI Run Result
description: The final outcome record for a run, written to result.json in the run's artifact directory.

schema.description: Identifies the schema and version this document conforms to.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this result belongs to.

status.description: The final outcome of the run.

failure_class.description: Present when status is 'failed': the failure taxonomy classification, matching the failure-class schema.

provider.description: The provider that ultimately executed the run.

attempts.description: Number of attempts made during this run.
